title: Safe-ICE: Safe Cross-Entropy-Based Importance Sampling for rare event simulation
description: A Python implementation of the Safe Cross-Entropy-Based Importance Sampling (Safe-ICE) algorithm for estimating small failure probabilities in reliability analysis, including the von Mises-Fisher-Nakagami mixture model, a penalized EM optimizer for automatic component selection, and heavy-tailed exploration via the inverse Nakagami distribution.
